Notes: Battery replaced with OEM battery. Previous battery was not OEM.
Alignment performed - Wheel was off-center. All good now.
Replaced corroding brake leader lines going to calipers. No calipers needed replaced, just the leader lines.

Reflashed and updated the PCM to enable Bluetooth, USB, and Auxiliary inputs.
Steering wheel off center after work was done. Will return for this fix.
New Spark plugs and bore scope. Bore’s show very small wear. 3/10 according to shop. Excellent shape and great news.
Serpentine belt, drive, tensioner, and roller were all replaced.

Power Steering Rack Replaced. During the removal of the inner tie rods, the power steering gear inner seal right side was found to be leaking. Installed aftermarket steering rack with new outer tie rods. The p/s gear came with inner tie rods and boots already installed. Installed new outer tie rods. Reinstalled P/S gear. Filled with new power steering fluid. Tested. P/S works well.

Front coolant lines are leaking. During the removal attempt the corrosion at the fittings was too great and the main Aluminum hard water pipes came apart. Replaced front coolant lines from the rear of the front subframe to the radiator connections at the front fender liners. Filled system with new coolant. Tested. Leak is no longer preset.

Suspension replacement. B16 Damptronic install. Replaced top mounts, sway bar links, corroded hardware.

Removed old, worn, and corroded suspension. Installed Bilstein B16 Damtronic coil over with PASM with new strut mounts and bearings. Installed new front and rear sway bar links. Test drove. Drives well. PASM is now very responsive.
Hood Struts Replaced. Removed old failed hood struts. Installed new hood struts. tested. The Front frunk hood stays up.
